subject_definitions: <Picture 1> is the uploaded 地理 reference at order 1. <Subject 1> is the cramped downstairs artist studio in <Picture 1>, with stacked frames, rough work surfaces, a low ceiling, and dense painter's clutter. <Picture 2> is the uploaded 身份 reference at order 2. <Subject 2> is Behrman in <Picture 2>, with a broad-shouldered elderly man with a dense grey-white beard and a worn dark-blue paint-stained coat.
summary: [reference generation] The target video is a single vertical period-drama shot in the early-1900s New York artist-apartment world. Behrman chooses action, extinguishes the lamp, and follows the young woman toward the stairs. The shot uses <Subject 1>, <Subject 2> as its visual references.

detailed_description: The target video is a realistic live-action period drama in a vertical 9:16 frame, with restrained natural light, tactile period materials, and observational camera movement. <Subject 1> remains anchored by the crate, blank dusty canvas, stacked frames, and the small glowing table lamp. Behrman stands beside the crate, identified by <Subject 2>. At 0.00 to 1.50 seconds the young woman has already turned toward the stairwell. At 1.50 to 2.20 seconds Behrman (S4) says: <d>[Chinese] 带路。</d> He reaches for the old blue coat. From 2.20 to 4.20 seconds he adds: <d>[Chinese] 我说的是叶子蠢。没说她该死。</d> while putting on the coat. From 4.20 to 5.40 seconds he blows out the table lamp and follows the young woman toward the stairs. From 5.40 to 6.00 seconds both figures clear the lower-room view and the blank canvas remains in the dimness. Use a slow sideward track that ends on the unlit canvas; one continuous take with no cut. No non-diegetic subtitles, captions, or dialogue text overlays appear at any moment. Continuity locks: faded blue-green high-collar blouse; worn dark-blue wool coat with paint-stained cuffs.
overall_soundscape: A coat sleeve brushing fabric, Behrman's rough voice, the small breath that extinguishes the lamp, wood steps beginning, and the downstairs room settling into darkness.
